facts.fact: Kazakh deputy PM Zhaslan Madiyev said Congo and Kazakhstan are working to build and launch Congo's first Earth-observation satellite, meant to help monitor forest resources, agricultural and mining activity and flood-exposed zones.

systems.system: Congo first Earth-observation satellite (Congo-Kazakhstan high-resolution space and remote-sensing system)

facts.fact: FAO's GIEWS country brief for the Republic of the Congo, reference date 23 June 2026, reports from satellite-based imagery that precipitation has been adequate and well distributed since December 2025 in most croplands, and lists GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring among its tools.
facts.system: FAO/GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring

systems.system: FAO/GIEWS Earth Observation for Crop Monitoring
